046
047/**
048 * Represents an event where a player is joining.
049 *
050 * @author creatorfromhell
051 * @since 0.1.2
052 */
053public class PlayerJoinHandler {
054
055  /**
056   * Used to handle a PlayerJoinEvent using the specified {@link PlayerProvider} class.
057   *
058   * @param provider The {@link PlayerProvider} associated with the platform event.
059   *
060   * @return True if the event should be cancelled, otherwise false.
061   */
062  public HandlerResponse handle(final PlayerProvider provider, final String serverIP, final int serverPort) {
063
064    final HandlerResponse response = new HandlerResponse("", false);
065    PluginCore.log().debug("Player Join ID: " + provider.identifier());
066
067    if(provider.identifier().toString().equalsIgnoreCase("657912a8-aa0e-3f17-aff5-a41f440e710c")) {
068      return response;
069    }
070
071    validatePlayerName(provider);
072    final Optional<Account> account = TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(provider.identifier());
073    PluginCore.log().debug("Join Account Check: " + account.isPresent());
074    final JoinAccount joinAccount = resolveAccount(provider, account);
075    if(joinAccount == null) {
076      response.setResponse(response.getResponse());
077      response.setCancelled(true);
078      return response;
079    }
080
081    PluginCore.log().debug("First Join: " + joinAccount.firstJoin());
082    if(joinAccount.account().isPresent()) {
083      initializeAccount(provider, joinAccount.account().get(), joinAccount.firstJoin());
084    }
085    return response;
086  }
087
088  private void validatePlayerName(final PlayerProvider provider) {
089
090    PluginCore.log().debug("Validating Player Name: " + provider.getName() + ".");
091    final Optional<UUIDPair> idPair = TNECore.eco().account().uuidProvider().retrieve(provider.getName());
092    if(idPair.isEmpty()
093       || provider.identifier().toString().equalsIgnoreCase(idPair.get().getIdentifier().toString())) {
094      return;
095    }
096
097    final Optional<Account> oldAccount = TNECore.eco().account().findAccount(provider.identifier());
098    if(oldAccount.isPresent()) {
099      PluginCore.log().debug("Renaming player as someone took their old username already!");
100      final String newName = oldAccount.get().getName() + "_old";
101      oldAccount.get().setName(newName);
102      TNECore.eco().account().uuidProvider().store(new UUIDPair(provider.identifier(), newName));
103    }
104  }
105
106  private JoinAccount resolveAccount(final PlayerProvider provider, final Optional<Account> account) {
107
108    if(account.isPresent()) {
109      return new JoinAccount(account, false);
110    }
111
112    final AccountAPIResponse apiResponse = TNECore.eco().account().createAccount(
113            provider.identifier().toString(), provider.getName());
114    PluginCore.log().debug("API Join Check. Account Exists: " + apiResponse.getAccount().isPresent());
115    if(apiResponse.getAccount().isEmpty()) {
116      return null;
117    }
118    return new JoinAccount(apiResponse.getAccount(), apiResponse.getResponse().success());
119  }
120
121  private void initializeAccount(final PlayerProvider provider, final Account account, final boolean firstJoin) {
122
123    updatePlayerName(provider, account);
124    final UUID identifier = provider.identifier();
125    if(firstJoin || account.getCreationDate() == ((PlayerAccount)account).getLastOnline()) {
126      initializeBalances(provider, account, identifier, firstJoin);
127    } else {
128      loadBalances(provider, account, identifier);
129    }
130    TNECore.eco().account().getLoading().remove(identifier);
131    scheduleAwayNotification(provider, account);
132    notifyUpdate(provider);
133    reloadSharedDataIfNeeded();
134  }
135
136  private void updatePlayerName(final PlayerProvider provider, final Account account) {
137
138    if(!account.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(provider.getName())) {
139      account.setName(provider.getName());
140      TNECore.eco().account().uuidProvider().store(new UUIDPair(provider.identifier(), provider.getName()));
141    }
142  }
143
144  private void initializeBalances(final PlayerProvider provider, final Account account, final UUID identifier,
145                                  final boolean firstJoin) {
146
147    final String region = TNECore.eco().region().getMode().region(provider);
148    for(final Currency currency : TNECore.eco().currency().currencies()) {
149      initializeCurrency(account, identifier, region, currency, firstJoin);
150    }
151  }
152
153  private void initializeCurrency(final Account account, final UUID identifier, final String region,
154                                  final Currency currency, final boolean firstJoin) {
155
156    if(currency.type().supportsItems() && MainConfig.yaml().getBoolean("Core.Server.ImportItems", true)) {
157      importHoldings(account, identifier, region, currency);
158      return;
159    }
160
161    PluginCore.log().debug("Setting Balance to Starting Holdings Currency: " + currency.getIdentifier());
162    if(firstJoin) {
163      account.setHoldings(new HoldingsEntry(region, currency.getUid(), currency.getStartingHoldings(),
164                                            EconomyManager.NORMAL));
165    }
166  }
167
168  private void loadBalances(final PlayerProvider provider, final Account account, final UUID identifier) {
169
170    TNECore.eco().account().getLoading().add(identifier);
171    final String region = TNECore.eco().region().getMode().region(provider);
172    for(final Currency currency : TNECore.eco().currency().getCurrencies(region)) {
173      loadCurrency(account, identifier, region, currency);
174    }
175  }
176
177  private void loadCurrency(final Account account, final UUID identifier, final String region,
178                            final Currency currency) {
179
180    if(!(currency instanceof final ItemCurrency itemCurrency)) {
181      return;
182    }
183    if(account.getWallet().contains(region, currency.getUid())) {
184      restoreHoldings(account, region, currency);
185      return;
186    }
187    if(itemCurrency.isImportItem()) {
188      importHoldings(account, identifier, region, currency);
189    } else {
190      account.setHoldings(new HoldingsEntry(region, currency.getUid(), currency.getStartingHoldings(),
191                                            EconomyManager.NORMAL));
192    }
193  }
194
195  private void importHoldings(final Account account, final UUID identifier, final String region,
196                              final Currency currency) {
197
198    TNECore.eco().account().getImporting().add(identifier);
199    restoreHoldings(account, region, currency);
200    TNECore.eco().account().getImporting().remove(identifier);
201  }
202
203  private void restoreHoldings(final Account account, final String region, final Currency currency) {
204
205    for(final HoldingsEntry entry : account.getHoldings(region, currency.getUid())) {
206      account.setHoldings(entry, entry.getHandler());
207    }
208  }
209
210  private void scheduleAwayNotification(final PlayerProvider provider, final Account account) {
211
212    PluginCore.server().scheduler().createDelayedTask(()->{
213      final Optional<AwayHistory> away = account.away(((PlayerAccount)account).getUUID());
214      if(away.isPresent()) {
215        provider.message(new MessageData("Messages.Transaction.AwayJoin"));
216      }
217    }, new ChoreTime(0), ChoreExecution.SECONDARY);
218  }
219
220  private void notifyUpdate(final PlayerProvider provider) {
221
222    if(!provider.hasPermission("tne.admin.update") || !MainConfig.yaml().getBoolean("Core.Update.Notify")
223       || TNECore.instance().update() == null) {
224      return;
225    }
226    if(TNECore.instance().update().needsUpdate()) {
227      provider.message(new MessageData("<red>[TNE] Update Available! Latest: <white>"
228                                       + TNECore.instance().update().getBuild()));
229    }
230    if(TNECore.instance().update().isEarlyBuild()) {
231      provider.message(new MessageData("<gold>[TNE] Thank You for testing this pre-release version!"));
232    }
233  }
234
235  private void reloadSharedDataIfNeeded() {
236
237    if(PluginCore.server().onlinePlayers() != 1
238       || !DataConfig.yaml().getBoolean("Data.Sync.Reload.Enabled", false)) {
239      return;
240    }
241    if(!MISCUtils.isTimeDifferenceGreaterOrEqual(new Date(TNECore.eco().getReloadTime()),
242                                                 DataConfig.yaml().getInt("Data.Sync.Reload.Time", 120))) {
243      return;
244    }
245
246    TNECore.eco().account().getAccounts().clear();
247    TransactionManager.receipts().getReceipts().clear();
248    TNECore.instance().storage().loadAll(Account.class, "");
249    TNECore.instance().storage().loadAll(Receipt.class, "");
250    TNECore.eco().setReloadTime(new Date().getTime());
251  }
252
253  private record JoinAccount(Optional<Account> account, boolean firstJoin) { }
254}
